notes: Playable source episodes for data/segments.json (#182). Keyed by the same `item_id` a segment carries, so a segment's timestamps resolve to an audio file. NOT data/discover.json: that file is machine-owned (tools/refresh/merge.mjs rewrites it wholesale and resolve.mjs mints its own ids), and it is the recommendation pool — the hand-picked curation sources do not belong in it. Every audio_url is the publisher's own enclosure, unmodified (product principle #3), and was verified with a 2-byte ranged GET returning HTTP 206. Invariants are checked by tools/foray/check-forays.mjs; re-verify the URLs with tools/foray/verify-source-audio.mjs.

provenance.method: Enclosure URLs read from the publishers' own feeds; ad-free ratio = Content-Range total / feed-declared enclosure length via a 2-byte ranged GET (the method in docs/curation/grilling-asr-manifest.json).
provenance.ad_delta_method: delta_sec = feed-declared bytes vs delivered bytes at the episode’s own measured bitrate (delivered_bytes*8/decoded_duration), not ratio x itunes:duration — several feeds here declare a duration that is itself tens of seconds wrong. N=3 (two probes in docs/curation/foray2-asr-manifest.json plus one on 2026-08-16); spread 0.0 s on all eight.
